summary: Frontend-only regression of Phase Α (Διπλογραφικά) + panel redesign (sidebar/favourites/mobile drawer, date-range, calm/dark theme) + accountant panel (office dashboard, alerts, closing, bulk, 'Διαχειριστής βιβλίων'). All 13 items from the spec are working. Only two minor deviations from the written spec (widget move testid naming and a 404 /logout route). No critical, no functional bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec asks for widget-move-<id> buttons but implementation exposes widget-up-<id> + widget-down-<id> instead (7 of each visible in edit mode). Functionality is equivalent but the data-testid naming does not match the review request.

Navigating to /logout directly returns a 404 HTML page (404s in console for that navigation). Logout only works via the OrgSwitcher dropdown menu item ('Αποσύνδεση'). Not blocking (dropdown works) but a dedicated /logout route (or middleware redirect calling logoutAction) would be a small robustness win.

action_items: LOW: Align widget-move test-ids with spec — rename widget-up-<id>/widget-down-<id> to widget-move-<id>-up/widget-move-<id>-down (or expose both) so the review-agent selector [data-testid^="widget-move-"] finds them.
LOW: Add a /logout GET route (server component that calls logoutAction() and redirects to /login) so opening /logout does not 404.
critical_code_review_comments: gl.ts::balanceSheet uses `pick(['54'])` for taxesDue, which correctly sweeps 54.00/54.03/54.09 subaccounts, but note the same startsWith('54') would also match a future '540'/'541' primary — safer to compare account.type==='liability' and code startsWith('54.'). Same pattern for '38' cash and '30' receivables (works for current chart, but is code-prefix-based).

gl.ts::generateEntries uses have=Set of `${sourceType}:${sourceId}` to guarantee idempotency of postEntry() calls. Good. However when a source document is later cancelled or amended, no reverse entry is generated — future phase should add a 'regenerate' path that first deletes stale entries by sourceId.

gl-ui.tsx ManualEntryForm: client-side disables the save button for unbalanced or empty description, but the underlying server action still throws with the Greek message when called directly. UX is fine; keep the server-side guard.

app-sidebar.tsx: NavLinks reads/writes localStorage during render inside a useEffect (OK). The Item component is declared inside NavLinks — recreated on every render which prevents React from memoising rows in a long menu. Consider moving it out to a stable component.
office-dashboard-grid.tsx: widget re-ordering exposes up/down, but no keyboard-drag (a11y), and no widget-move-<id> testids as the spec expected — either alias or rename.

success_rate.frontend: ≈97% — all 13 spec items pass; 2 LOW naming/route deviations

Test-ids that differ from spec: use widget-up-<id>/widget-down-<id> (not widget-move-<id>) and alerts-client-<orgId> (not a select) for the org filter.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional issue to root-cause. The two LOW findings are purely (1) test-id naming (widget-up/down vs widget-move) and (2) missing /logout GET route (logout is only reachable via the OrgSwitcher dropdown that calls logoutAction). Both are cosmetic and do not affect any user flow.
